policies.equipped: loadout equipped weapons, or hotbar weapons in standalone mode
policies.chain: each weapon damage instance must follow the previous one within 7s; timer disabled while active
policies.damage: captured at emission; projectiles keep the buff they were fired with

source.officialDescription: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.
source.ddcText: 25 Bait and Switch Upon scoring a damage instance with each equipped weapon within 7 seconds of the last damage instance : 30% increased damage for 10 ↑11 seconds. Buff cannot be refreshed until its duration expires. Damage Timer is disabled while the perk is active. Buff persists through stow.
source.scope: PvE base (non-enhanced); '?' values are not facts, see policies
